'''February 2001 Tucson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Things For Thinkers, Tucson, Arizona on 17 February 2001. [[Steve Marshall]] won it. It is known from Steve Marshall's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1745">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-viper-gets-detoured-tucson-az-2-17-01d1745/ viper-gets-detoured-tucson-az-2-17-01], DeckTech (Steve "BlackViper" Marshall, 19 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-19-viper-gets-detoured-tucson-az-2-17-01d1745/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Things For Thinkers, Tucson, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Steve Marshall]]
